name: phase-add-refuses-existing
body: `apg plan add <project> phase <n> …` must refuse when phase `<n>` already exists in the plan, naming the entity and pointing at `apg plan update <project> phase <n>` or `apg plan rm`. Today `plan_add_phase_at` (src/plan_cmd.rs:233–288) calls `artifacts::remove_node(records, &fqn)` (line 253) then re-appends the phase — an upsert that drops the phase's `Contains` edges to its tasks, orphaning them. Acceptance: re-adding an existing phase exits non-zero with no plan-file change; the phase's existing task `Contains` edges survive.
